shots.motion_prompt: A cheerful white pelican naturally rides and pedals the blue bicycle forward from left to right along the sunny seaside promenade. Both bicycle wheels rotate smoothly, the pelican's legs pedal continuously, its body balances gently, and its feathers and the nearby palm leaves move subtly in the sea breeze. The camera tracks alongside at a steady pace. Bright cinematic daylight, coherent natural motion.
shots.negative_prompt: distorted bicycle, extra legs, extra wings, fused limbs, deformed beak, identity change, stationary wheels, backward motion, camera shake, flicker, text, logo, watermark
motion_constraints: preserve the same white pelican identity and orange beak
preserve the blue bicycle geometry and two wheels
preserve the sunny seaside promenade composition
continuous forward pedaling with smooth wheel rotation

demo.selection_reason: Validate prompt-controlled pelican cycling with SkyReels-V2 I2V 1.3B on one Kaggle T4
validation_goals: pelican pedals and bicycle wheels rotate
no severe flicker or geometry collapse
